whoItsFor: TypeScript developers and teams who want a faster, drop-in replacement for the tsc command line, language server, or API. It also suits Effect projects, which get the Effect language service diagnostics without a second compiler.
useCases: Type checking existing TypeScript projects faster with the tsc-compatible CLI (npx tsc-rs -p tsconfig.json)
Running Effect language service diagnostics in the same compile as TypeScript checks
Powering a fast TypeScript language server or type checker that can run in WASM

requirements.os: Linux x64 and arm64, macOS arm64; macOS x64, Windows x64 and Windows arm64 from the first release after 0.2.0
